entities.summary: Rudolf Schwarzkogler was an Austrian performance artist closely associated with the Viennese Actionism group that included artists Günter Brus, Otto Mühl, and Hermann Nitsch. Rudolf Schwarzkogler was a painters & sculptors from Vienna (1940-11-13, Vienna–1969-06-20). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
